Tuji Sobit Sundor kantaram Aikonkh Kushalkai bhogta Mojea Jivak Itli ,Mojean Sangonk Zaina Poi Titli .
Thosot , Tuzo Modhur tallo Aikon 
Aum Sontosbhorit zata Italo .
Mojean Tukam Uttranni Sangonk Zaina poi Titlo 

Kitleam Ruchik. tum tujeam  kantar  Kortai ,Ani Kantarachim  tum Sobitai Vadoitai, Thoxench,Kitleam Mogan ani urben tum tujeam Ek ek Utor kantarachem  amcheam Kanar Sadoitai An Amchim i kalzan Kushalkaiean Bortai ,Aikotus Tukam,Jiv Mhozo  urtam,
Kushalbhorit ani Anandbhorit.

Thoxench Tujeam Godpak Vodlo Man Favo,Sobit Apurbaichim utram
 Ani tune Boson, Tum Kushalkaiean, bortai,tum amcho.
 Dis Novo ..
Dekhun Surekh Sundor album Tuzo Maka Aikonkh Sodans Zavo .


Deu Borem korum Tukam 
Avers PEREIRA 
Aicheam Sobit DISAK 
Devan Tukam Sodans Saud-Boliaken ani Kushal DORCHO Ani Anik Denenim BORCHO.
TUZO UPKARI 
Jerry Britto 
SODANS ASTOLOM
